informal_statement: The type-\(\mathrm C\) inverse chart is \(b(R)=\arctan(1/R)\).
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:131-132`: Lean defines \(\arctan (1/R)\) as a total real expression. The author uses inverse-chart language only for \(R>0\) and correctly avoids attributing geometric meaning to the value at zero.
